name: Lockfile-scoped shared worktree dependency store
target: Same-lock worktrees reuse one isolated store while changed locks install independently, interrupted locks recover, and concurrent creators publish one complete copy
inputs: concurrent linker starts and interrupted lock owner
observations: same-lock worktrees resolve to the same shared dependency store
changed-lock worktrees use an independent install
dead-owner locks recover and concurrent copies serialize
source dependency bytes remain unchanged and createdAt provenance is persisted
